task_language: put the butter at the back in the top drawer of the cabinet and close it

subtasks.name: pick(back_butter)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: no butter is touched

subtasks.name: place(back_butter, top_drawer, in)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted; the destination drawer is closed by ~80-100 and reopened ~240

subtasks.name: close(top_drawer)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted as part of the task (closed only before the place, wrongly)

behaviour_summary: pi0 goes straight to the open destination drawer and pushes it shut (40-100), then grabs the top handle and pulls it open again (160-240), and finally rests its fingertips on the black bowl rim (240-409). The butters are never approached.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 KITCHEN_SCENE4 'put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it' (drawer manipulation plus going for the bowl); medium-low confidence

failures.mode_definition: pi0 runs the scene's habitual/trained-task behaviour instead of the instructed one, approaching a non-target object or fixture (and may destroy a precondition).
failures.hl_remedy: HALT -> RETREAT(up 10 cm, 5 cm away from cabinet) -> VERIFY(top drawer open); if closed INSERT_SUBTASK 'open the top drawer of the cabinet' -> REPROMPT 'pick up the butter at the back and place it in the top drawer of the cabinet' -> WATCH 5 s for an approach to the back butter -> VERIFY(butter in drawer) -> REPROMPT 'close the top drawer of the cabinet'; retry once with a 15 cm retreat, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Declare 'top drawer open' as a protected state until the butter is inside; HALT on the first violation or when the empty gripper heads for the drawer.
failures.observation: Step 40: gripper above the table heading to the cabinet. 60-80: on the drawer, pushing it shut; by 80-120 it is (nearly) closed. 160-200: gripper at the top handle; by 240 the drawer is pulled open again. 240-409: fingertips on the black bowl rim beside the cabinet (wrong object; possibly the bowl of the trained libero_10 task). Butters and pudding untouched.

notes: The bowl approach after the reopen is treated as part of the same trained-task replay rather than a separate failure. Whether the bowl was actually grasped cannot be told at 1 fps.
